# Built plugins

The DLLs as installed and tested, one per mod. Copy into `Graveyard Keeper 2\BepInEx\plugins\`.

| File | Version | Game build |
|---|---|---|
| `GK2GlobalStorage.dll` | 1.1.3 | 25601286 |
| `GK2BuiltCount.dll` | 1.0.4 | 25601286 |
| `GK2MoveBuilding.dll` | 1.1.4 | 25601286 |
| `GK2OwnedCount.dll` | 1.0.3 | 25601286 |

Each plugin disables itself on a different game build until it has been re-audited and rebuilt.

`GK2OwnedCount.dll` also shows in the game's Mods menu when
[GK2 Mod Framework](https://www.nexusmods.com/graveyardkeeper2/mods/42) is installed. The framework is optional,
and it isn't included here.
